intro: Laughing kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces caught mid-laugh: a small giggle, a big cackle, or rolling on the floor. A laughing kaomoji such as (≧▽≦) or ( ﾟ∀ﾟ)ｱﾊﾊ八八 is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and chats. Browse by volume below and click any face to copy it instantly. Whether you search "laughing kaomoji" or "kaomoji laughing," every face here is free to copy and paste. ಥ and ᗜ come from Kannada and Canadian syllabics, so a device without those fonts shows a box in their place.

sections.label: Happy Crying
sections.intro: Tears of joy: laughing until you cry, or crying because something is that sweet. ಥ is a Kannada letter that reads as an eye brimming with tears, and ﾟ。 at the sides are the drops flying off.
